hyperkalemia.title: Hyperkalemia

immediate.caution: Do NOT mix with bicarbonate in same line.

shift_k.dose: 10 units insulin + 50 ml D25 IV over 30 min
shift_k.why: Shifts K+ intracellularly. Check BSL hourly.

remove_k.why: Removes K+ from body. Takes 1-2 hours.

hyperkalemia.ecg: Get stat. Look for peaked T-waves, wide QRS, sine wave.
hyperkalemia.escalate: Call senior if K+ not improving after 2 hours or ECG worsening.
